title: Underscore names either side of the NP-022 trap all survive - pinning exactly where it starts
rationale: The NP-022 predicate is startsWith("__") && endsWith("__"). These four names each satisfy at most one half and must all survive. Without this boundary fixture an over-broad fix would satisfy the NP-022 fixtures while quietly breaking legitimate names. This is the good-input arm of the NP-022 drill.
catchesBugClass: Over-broad remediation of NP-022, and any regression in escaping a segment that is entirely separator characters.
cannotCatch: It cannot distinguish a correct fix from a fix that merely narrows the predicate. Only paired with the two NP-022 DEFECT fixtures does it constrain the fix from both sides.

predicted.detail: All four decode to their exact source names; __x fails endsWith, x__ fails startsWith, and _ fails both, so processArrays keeps all of them.
